After gaining the upper hand in the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaigns]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] invaded the remaining territory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], '''taking''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in heart of Imperial Space.
